_about: Status effects. duration_turns counts the afflicted fighter's own turns. Flags: hp_loss_pct (per turn, floored at min_hp_loss), can_down (false = it can't finish you off), blocks_skills, random_target_chance, skips_turn, window_mult (Clutch window size), clears_after_battle. Down for the Count is not a timer: it is HP 0 (the model's down flag) and is described here for text and tests.

statuses.name: Burnt Toast
statuses.desc: Loses a bit of HP every turn.

statuses.name: Noise Ticket
statuses.desc: Can't use Skills for a few turns.

statuses.name: Wobbly
statuses.desc: Hits a random target, sometimes a friend. (Porch Light's blinding flare uses this one.)

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.desc: Skips the next turn. (Heave-Ho's perfect release.)

statuses.name: Down for the Count
statuses.desc: Knocked out at 0 HP. Bring them back with an item or skill.
